meta.title: 3分钟学会拍出超清晰视频
meta.title_en: Learn to Shoot Ultra-Clear Video in 3 Minutes

scenes.title_cn: 谜题：4K 为什么不如 1080P 清晰
scenes.title_en: The Puzzle: Why 4K Looks Less Sharp Than 1080P
scenes.context: 4K 与 1080P 对比，4K 反而不清晰。原因在光：光线不足产生噪点、细节模糊、主体背景糊在一起。
sentences: 这是4K画面，这是1080P画面。为什么4K画面看起来还没有1080P清晰？
This is 4K footage, and this is 1080P. Why does the 4K look less sharp than the 1080P?
4K footage（4K画面）
光线不足会导致画面出现噪点，让细节模糊，明暗反差会感觉主体和背景糊在一起。
Poor light causes noise, blurs the detail, and the weak contrast makes subject and background blend together.
noise（噪点）
paraphrase: Subject and background melt into one.
scenes.speak: This is 4K footage, and this is 1080P. Why does the 4K look less sharp than the 1080P? Poor light causes noise, blurs the detail, and the weak contrast makes subject and background blend together.

scenes.title_en: Basic Fixes: Window Light and Extra Lamps
scenes.context: 最简单的解法是靠近窗户用自然光；窗户小就加灯。但均匀提亮环境不等于清晰。
sentences: 最简单的解决方法就是靠近家中的窗户。
The simplest fix is to move close to a window in your home.
move close to a window（靠近窗户）
如果只是简单地提亮整体的环境，看起来好像也不是很清晰。
If you simply brighten the whole scene evenly, it still doesn't look very sharp.
brighten the whole scene（提亮整体环境）
paraphrase: Small window? Bring in a lamp.
scenes.speak: The simplest fix is to move close to a window in your home. If you simply brighten the whole scene evenly, it still doesn't look very sharp.

scenes.context: 干净背景的镜头天然清晰，复杂环境要制造明暗反差：45度单独打亮人物，让主体比背景亮。
sentences: 在复杂的环境中，我们需要制造明暗反差，才能让主体从背景中站出来。
In busy environments we need to create light-dark contrast so the subject can stand out from the background.
stand out from the background（从背景中站出来）
从45度单独打亮人物，让主体比背景亮一些，画面有了反差就会显得很清晰。
Light the person alone from 45 degrees, making the subject brighter than the background — the contrast makes the shot look sharp.
from 45 degrees（45度角）
paraphrase: Build a contrast between light and dark.
Let the subject outshine the background.
scenes.speak: In busy environments we need to create light-dark contrast so the subject can stand out from the background. Light the person alone from 45 degrees, making the subject brighter than the background — the contrast makes the shot look sharp.

scenes.context: 晚上只有一盏灯时人物与背景糊在一起，用台灯或日落灯增加背景光，分离人物与背景。
sentences: 我们可以用家里的台灯或者日落灯，增加背景光，让人物和背景分离出来。
We can use a desk lamp or a sunset lamp at home to add backlight and separate the person from the background.
backlight（背景光/逆光）
paraphrase: Add a rim of light behind the subject.
Carve the subject out of the dark.
scenes.speak: We can use a desk lamp or a sunset lamp at home to add backlight and separate the person from the background.

scenes.context: 电影常用的方式：主体与背景颜色形成对比色，主体更鲜明突出。
sentences: 让主体的颜色和背景的颜色形成对比色，主体就会更加的鲜明突出。
Put the subject's color against a complementary color in the background, and the subject pops out more.
complementary colors（对比色）
scenes.speak: Put the subject's color against a complementary color in the background, and the subject pops out more.

scenes.title_cn: 后期补救：对比度与饱和度
scenes.context: 拍完的画面也能补救：明暗反差不够就增加整体对比度；饱和度不够就调整饱和度数值。
sentences: 如果只是画面看起来明暗反差不够，那就增加整体的对比度。
If the shot just lacks contrast, raise the overall contrast.
raise the overall contrast（增加整体对比度）
画面有色彩但是饱和度不够，也会看着不清晰，可以在后期软件中调整饱和度数值。
If there's color but not enough saturation, it also looks soft — bump up the saturation in editing.
saturation（饱和度）
paraphrase: The image looks flat and muddy.
scenes.speak: If the shot just lacks contrast, raise the overall contrast. If there's color but not enough saturation, it also looks soft — bump up the saturation in editing.

scenes.context: 尽量 4K 拍摄（细节多、能二次构图），导出 4K+最高码率+H.264，用电脑端网页上传画质更好。
sentences: 不管是用什么拍摄设备，都尽量选择4K分辨率来拍摄。
Whatever device you shoot with, try to shoot at 4K resolution.
shoot at 4K（用4K拍摄）
4K不仅比1080P有更多的细节，还能二次构图减少多余元素。
4K holds more detail than 1080P and also lets you re-frame to remove distracting elements.
re-frame（二次构图）
导出分辨率我会选4K，码率调到最高，编码选H.264。
For export I pick 4K resolution, max bitrate, and H.264 encoding.
bitrate（码率）/ H.264
paraphrase: Crank the bitrate to the max.
The web upload keeps more quality than the app.
scenes.speak: Whatever device you shoot with, try to shoot at 4K resolution. 4K holds more detail than 1080P and also lets you re-frame to remove distracting elements. For export I pick 4K resolution, max bitrate, and H.264 encoding.

practice.a: Light the subject alone from 45 degrees.

practice.q: 「主体从背景中站出来」怎么说？
practice.a: Let the subject stand out from the background.
Export at 4K with max bitrate and H.264.

pitfalls: Buy a 4K camera and expect sharp video automatically.
Fix the light first — 4K without light is still soft.
Resolution sets the ceiling, light decides what you actually see.
Evenly brighten the whole scene to make it sharp.
Create contrast: light the subject more than the background.
Even brightness has no depth; subject and background stay merged.
Rely on post-processing to fix everything.
Get the contrast in-camera, use post only as a rescue.
No contrast captured means nothing to rescue later.
shifts: 觉得换 4K 设备画面就清晰，拍完再猛拉后期
先保光线与反差，4K 只是保细节上限
difficult_words: The subject stands out from the background.
Complementary colors make the subject pop.
footer_notes: 原视频为视频清晰度教程（作者：王崧惟），英文为场景意译，适合跟读练习拍摄类表达；ASR 已按语境校正（信息→清晰、体谅→提亮、月光→灯光）。
